label: H.R. 10455
title: Debt-Free College Act of 2026

items.snippet: This bill establishes measures to cover the unmet financial need of students who are enrolled at certain institutions of higher education (IHEs).
This bill establishes measures to cover the unmet financial need of students who are enrolled at certain institutions of higher education (IHEs).
First, the bill requires the Department of Education (ED) to award grants for state-federal partnerships with a goal of providing debt-free college for all eligible students at in-state public IHEs.

items.item: Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA)
items.snippet: …to an individual who (1) is enrolled or is eligible to enroll in an in-state public IHE, and (2) completes a Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) or demonstrates eligibility for a Federal Pell Grant through state or institutional financial aid…
Next, the bill requires ED to award grants to historically Black colleges and universities and minority-serving institutions to cover the unmet financial need of enrolled students.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

P000607.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
P000607.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
P000607.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
